installCommand: if [ -d flutter ]; then git -C flutter pull; else git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --branch 3.47.7 --depth 1; fi && flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web --no-analytics && flutter/bin/flutter pub get
buildCommand: flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --no-tree-shake-icons && bash tool/fetch_tdweb.sh build/web
